_about: overlay for a typical hand-written DB wrapper: `$db->query(...)` is the sink, `$db->escape(...)` substitutes for the quoted SQL context. Method keys may be receiver-qualified: `$db->escape` and `$out->escape` are different acts. A singleton reached THROUGH A PROPERTY is its own key too: `Reg::$db->escape` and `$app->db->escape`.
